add: · have e : (l+k)*(q*r) ≤ B*(p*r+t*q) := by simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_right r a.1) (Nat.mul_le_mul_right q b.1)

· have e : B*(p*r+t*q) ≤ (h+j)*(q*r) := by simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_right r a.2) (Nat.mul_le_mul_right q b.2)
allPrefixes: have h := initial_interval n d (scale s) hd
have z : enclosedPrefix n d s 0 := by simpa [enclosedPrefix, partialSum, loopState, start, Encl] using h
rcases ih with ⟨hp, hl, hh, hsl, hsh⟩
let v := loopState n d s i
let t := partialSum n d i
have power : Encl (scale s) v.lo v.hi (n^k) (d^k) := ⟨hl, hh⟩
have sums : Encl (scale s) v.sumLo v.sumHi t.1 t.2 := ⟨hsl, hsh⟩
have next := product_interval (Nat.two_pow_pos s) power (square_steps n d s hd)
have total := add_interval sums (term_interval hk power)
have hden : 0 < t.2*(d^k*k) := Nat.mul_pos hp (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pow_pos hd) hk)
lowerProduct: _ = B*(p*t)*B := by simp only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm]
product: exact ⟨product_lower hB a.1 b.1, product_upper hB a.2 b.2⟩
returnFinite: obtain ⟨hp, hl, hh, hsl, hsh⟩ := all_prefixes n d s (count s) hd
exact Nat.add_le_add_right hsh (partialSum n d (count s)).2
scheduled: · intro n d p hd hdom hp
exact all_prefixes n d (internalBits p) i hd
· exact returned_finite n d (internalBits p) hd
square: have init := initial_interval n d (scale s) hd
term: _ = B*(2*p) := by simp only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm]
B*(2*p) = 2*(B*p) := by simp only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm]
_ = up (2*h) k*(q*k) := by simp only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm]
upper: rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_comm b ((a + (b - 1)) / b)] at h
upperProduct: B*(p*t)*B = (B*p)*(B*t) := by simp only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm]
_ = (up (h*k) B*(q*r))*B := by simp only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm]
